request.query: natural floor square divided by two bounded by sum of a minus integers

items.name: Nat.add_div_le_add_div
items.type: ∀ (a b c : ℕ), a / c + b / c ≤ (a + b) / c

items.name: Int.div_two_lt_floor
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u_4} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : LinearOrder k] [IsStrictOrderedRing k] [inst_3 : FloorRing k] {a : k},
  1 ≤ a → a / 2 < ↑⌊a⌋

items.name: Nat.floor_sub_ofNat
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
  [inst_4 : Sub R] [OrderedSub R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) [inst_7 : n.AtLeastTwo],
  ⌊a - OfNat.ofNat n⌋₊ = ⌊a⌋₊ - OfNat.ofNat n

items.name: Nat.floor_div_natCast
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Semifield K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring K]
  (a : K) (n : ℕ), ⌊a / ↑n⌋₊ = ⌊a⌋₊ / n
